sentences.text: This is first application under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the applicant in connection with Crime No53/2022 registered at Police Station -Mahakal, Ujjain (M.P.) under Sections 363, 368, 376 (2)(n), 376(3), 342, 506/34 of IPC and under Section 3/4 and 5(N)/6 of POCSO Act.
It is alleged that the applicant has committed rape upon the minor prosecutrix.

sentences.text: Counsel for the applicant submits on the complaint of the prosecutrix initially the offences under Section 363 and 368 of IPC were registered.
The applicant was granted bail by the trial Court.
Thereafter, after a period of three months, the police has recorded the statements of the prosecutrix where she has made allegations of rape.

The medical was conducted after three months and initially,
no medical was conducted.
The applicant is in jail since 25.01.2022 the investigation has been completed and the charge-sheet has been filed.
Counsel for the State opposes the prayer for grant of bail and submits that age of the prosecutrix as per the prosecution is less than 15 years.
After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration that in the first complaint, the prosecutrix has not made any allegation regarding rape.
The applicant was granted bail by the trial Court.
Later on, the statements of the prosecutrix was recorded again under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. after three months where she has made allegations of rape.
The medical of the prosecutrix was conducted after three months also does not suggest any commission of rape.
The applicant is in jail since 25.01.2022, the charge-sheet has been filed and no further custodial interrogation is required, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled for grant of bail.

Therefore,
without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that applicant shall be released from custody upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Ld. Court below.

The prison authorities are also requested to ensure compliance with the order passed by the Supreme Court IN RE : CONTAGION OF COVID 19 VIRUS IN PRISONS in SUO MOTU "W.P. (C)
No.1/2020" and ensure that the applicant is examined by the jail doctor before his release.
If the applicant shows symptoms of COVID-19, the doctor shall forthwith direct him to be produced before the appropriate hospital designated for the detection and treatment of COVID-19 patients.
If the doctor is of the opinion that the applicant is not affected with the virus, the jail authorities shall ensure his transportation from the jail till his place of residence.

It is further made clear that if it is found that the applicant is involved in any other case during the trial, this bail order shall stand cancelled automatically without reference to the Court and the Police will be at liberty to arrest the applicant.
A typed copy of this order is being forwarded to the Office of the Advocate General, on their email address, for intimation to the Police Station concerned.
The office is requested to forward a copy of this order to the Ld. Court below.
